title: An artifact-only run turns its pipeline review off
description: Start an isolated gateway with engine start disabled. Through the checkout-local CLI, preview and create an artifact-only dev run with --no-pipeline-review, read it back with run.get, and check that dispatch.preview and run.create refuse pipelineReview none on update-branch, without artifact-only and for an unknown value. No worker, reviewer, operator tmux server, run or slot is used.

no-pipeline-review.intent: An artifact-only dev run keeps its pipeline review off and reads it back; every request it could not honor is refused and creates nothing.
